model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates values measured in thousands of hectares across a ten-year period for seven different countries or regions. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Години" (Years), displays discrete years arranged in chronological order from 2013 to 2022. The vertical value axis, labeled "Хиляди хектари" (Thousands of hectares), utilizes a linear scale with a range from 0 to 1200, featuring major numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 200. For each year on the horizontal axis, the chart displays a group of seven adjacent vertical bars. According to the legend positioned to the right of the plot area, each color corresponds to a specific region: blue represents "Испания" (Spain), orange represents "Франция" (France), grey represents "Китай/континентален/" (China/continental), yellow represents "Италия" (Italy), light blue represents "Турция" (Turkey), green represents "САЩ" (USA), and dark blue represents "Аржентина" (Argentina). Within each annual grouping, the bars are visually arranged from left to right in the exact sequence listed in the legend. Across all the years shown, the blue bars representing "Испания" are consistently the tallest, maintaining approximate values between 950 and 980. Conversely, the dark blue bars representing "Аржентина" are consistently the shortest, with approximate values hovering just above 200. The horizontal categories are sorted chronologically, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or specific annotations.
